judged_text: The reference builder changed non-calendar results from `credentialId: result.credentialId` to `credentialId: undefined`, so video booking references stop persisting the id of the credential that created the meeting. Booking references for video apps lose the credential linkage they have carried until now; consumers that match booking references by credentialId (e.g., credential-removal cleanup flows) silently stop finding video bookings created after this change.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the booking-reference objects now set `credentialId` only when `isCalendarType` is true: `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined` (and similarly later). Previously, non-calendar results (e.g., video apps) used `result.credentialId` (`credentialId: isCalendarType ? evt.destinationCalendar?.credentialId : result.credentialId`). This diff therefore stops persisting `credentialId` for video/other non-calendar booking references, matching the finding’s claim of lost credential linkage for those references.
